st: Heat [[2 tbsp]] oil in a pot. Cook the onion for 4 minutes, add the tomatoes and cook 5 minutes.
Add the okra, [[0.5 tsp]] salt and a cup of water. Simmer for 12 minutes until thick and slimy-smooth. This is the sauce.
Mix [[2 cup]] millet flour and [[1 cup]] sorghum flour in a bowl.
Bring [[3 cup]] water and [[0.5 tsp]] salt to a boil in a heavy pot. Stir in about a third of the flour mixture to make a thin porridge and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the remaining flour a handful at a time, stirring hard with a wooden spoon.
Cook on low for 8 minutes, folding and pressing, until a stiff, smooth dough forms.
Wet your hands and shape the dough into round balls. Serve warm with the okra sauce.
Heat [[3 tbsp]] oil in a large pot. Cook the onion and chili for 5 minutes.
Add the tomatoes and cook for 6 minutes until they break down.
Add the sweet potatoes, eggplant, [[1.5 tsp]] salt and [[3 cup]] water. Cover and simmer for 15 minutes.
Add the okra and simmer 10 minutes more.
Whisk [[0.25 cup]] peanut butter with a ladle of hot stew liquid until smooth, then stir it in.
Simmer for 8 minutes until the stew is thick and the vegetables are tender. Taste, adjust salt, and serve with rice or boule.
Whisk [[2 cup]] sorghum flour, [[0.5 cup]] all-purpose flour, [[0.5 tsp]] yeast, [[1 tsp]] sugar and [[0.5 tsp]] salt in a bowl.
Add [[2.5 cup]] warm water and whisk until the batter is smooth and thin.
Cover and ferment at room temperature for 8 hours or overnight, until bubbly and slightly sour.
Stir the batter and thin it with a splash of water if needed so it pours easily.
Heat a non-stick skillet over medium heat and wipe with a little of the [[1 tbsp]] oil.
Pour a small ladle of batter and swirl the pan quickly to spread it very thin.
Cook for 1 minute per side until set with lacy brown spots. Stack under a cloth and repeat.
Serve warm with stew or a sprinkle of sugar.
Season the shank with [[1.5 tsp]] salt and [[0.5 tsp]] pepper.
Heat [[3 tbsp]] oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat. Brown the beef for 10 minutes, turning, then remove it.
Cook the onions in the same pot for 6 minutes. Add the garlic for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes and cook for 8 minutes into a thick sauce.
Return the beef, add [[4 cup]] water and the whole chili. Bring to a boil, then cover and simmer on low for 2 hours.
Add the okra and simmer 20 minutes, until the meat is fall-apart tender (at least 145°F/63°C).
Remove the chili, taste for salt, and serve with rice or boule.
Whisk [[1 cup]] millet flour with [[1 cup]] cold water in a pot until smooth.
Add [[2 cup]] more water and [[0.25 tsp]] salt. Set over medium heat.
Cook for 12 minutes, stirring constantly, until the porridge thickens and no raw flour taste is left.
Pour in [[1.5 cup]] warm milk and stir to combine.
Simmer 5 more minutes on low heat, stirring.
Stir in [[2 tbsp]] butter and [[3 tbsp]] sugar, and serve hot in bowls.
Rinse [[1 cup]] hibiscus flowers under cold water.
Bring [[6 cup]] water to a boil in a pot with the ginger, cloves and cinnamon stick.
Add the hibiscus, turn off the heat, cover and steep for 20 minutes.
Strain into a pitcher, pressing the flowers to get all the color.
Stir in [[0.5 cup]] sugar while the liquid is warm until dissolved. Taste and add more if you like.
Chill for 2 hours, then serve over ice.
